sentences.text: No, a UCB may not capitalise penal charges or add further interest on them.
The documents say a UCB may charge interest on unpaid interest (including on unpaid EMI) at the contracted rate of interest till the date of remediation, and not at the penal rate of interest.

The documents also say there is no capitalization of the penal charges, i.e., no further interest computed on such charges, and additional / fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
